status: lost-retransmission recovery and late-SACK cancellation fixed; one physical file run passes, broader reliability and call quality remain unqualified

corrections.defect: Several lost retransmissions beneath a SACKed tail were repaired one per exponentially backed-off RTO because the permanent retransmitted marker excluded the remaining holes.
corrections.fix: At circuit-mode SACK RTO, mark all already-retransmitted proven holes whose own last actual handoff is at least the expired RTO old. Preserve the retransmitted marker for Karn, exclude locally pending/unhanded/recent repairs, and retain normal pacing and congestion policy.
parent_production_regressions_failed: core expired-hole regression in ordinary handoff mode
real async driver with SACK-count recovery
real async driver with RACK recovery
corrections.driver_evidence: Three head originals and their first repairs are lost after real local acceptance, while five tail segments arrive and are SACKed. All three holes now complete in one RTO window; each is sent exactly three times and each SACKed tail once. Tests also cover sequence wrap.
controls: Locally pending or unhanded repair remains unmarked.
Tail without enough higher SACKs remains unmarked.
Classic non-circuit RTO policy remains unchanged.

corrections.defect: A late SACK did not cancel a marked repair that pacing had not emitted yet.
corrections.fix: SACK admission clears that segment's needs_resend marker.
corrections.regression_provenance: Regression failed in the intermediate expired-repair implementation before the one-line cancellation correction; the affected ACK admission was still unchanged from the parent.
corrections.scope: Cancels an un-emitted repair decision. A duplicate already admitted to the carrier cannot be recalled.

limits: The controlled tests prove a real recovery mechanism; they do not reconstruct the exact previous WAN packet schedule.
One successful 32-MiB reverse run does not prove long-transfer stability or a universal throughput gain; WAN variation is not isolated.
Only already expired repairs with sufficient higher SACK evidence receive the new batch marking. Staggered repair ages and other loss schedules need further qualification.
No new 32-MiB phone-to-laptop case, full multi-device matrix, Windows run or audio/video call this cycle.
Driver waits are event-driven samples, not absolute maxima or network RTT.
privacy: Aggregate values only, without endpoint identifiers, addresses, paths, keys, packet sequences, raw captures or file hashes.
